def make_grid():
    grid = [[0]*12 for _ in range(12)]
    for r in range(12):

            dist_row = abs(r - 8)
            dist_col = abs(c - 6)
            max_dist = max(dist_row, dist_col)

                grid[r][c] = 5
            elif max_dist <= 1:  # 3x3 area
                grid[r][c] = 7
            elif max_dist <= 3:  # next layer
                grid[r][c] = 9
            else:  # outer edges
                grid[r][c] = 2
    return grid
